title: 第9章 化境第10章 异变
slug: 顶级悟性从修炼基础剑法开始
lines: 第九章化境
恐怖的气劲随之自阎息的掌绽放开来。
在空中掀起一阵气浪。
那一缕寒光也随之斩在阎息的右掌之上。
“啊。我的手。”
而随着那一缕寒光斩在那右掌上，阎息顿时发出一声凄厉的惨叫。
阎息左手握着右手，面色煞白，此时他的右手鲜血不断涌出，那右掌此时已然残缺了一半，五指如今只剩下半根食指和大拇指。
而方羽一击得手之后，在阎息的身侧，闪身而过，朝着一处矿洞爆射而去。
“该死的，刚才那是圆满境界的基础剑法？不对，圆满的基础剑法不可能有这等威力，难道是传说中的化境？小畜生，我不会放过你的，你跑得了和尚，跑得了庙吗？我就不信你不离开矿坑。”
阎息忍着右手的剧痛，面色狰狞的看着方羽远去的身影。
随后他急忙捡起地面上那一截断掌，朝着后方的甬道飞射而去，他要找矿坑的医师，接续断掌，否则过了那个时间，他的手掌真的就废了。
而此时方羽，迫切之下，却是已然进入第五层之中。
方羽刚进入第五层，就感受到一股寒意笼罩而来，不由自主的打了个寒颤。
“这第五层的寒意，居然比之第四层强了这么多。”
方羽身体微微颤抖的自语道。
仅仅这一会工夫，他感觉自己的四肢都有些僵硬了，可见这第五层寒意之盛。
方羽仓促的找了一个角落，将手中的木剑，放回靴子当中。
方羽刚才正是凭借这柄木剑，斩断阎息的右掌。
这柄木剑乃是方羽前段时间自制的。
这一个月来，方羽可不止将龙拳修炼至圆满。
方羽在悟境之中，仅仅花费了两天时间，就将龙拳第一式修炼至圆满。
而其余八天的时间，方羽则是都用来修炼剑法。
不过方羽没有修炼任何剑诀，而是仅仅修炼基础剑法。
基础剑法十三式：抽、带、提、格、击、刺，点、崩、搅、压、劈、截、洗。
这一个月时间内，方羽利用晚上进入悟境中。
不断修炼这基础剑法，仅仅一个月时间，却已经将这基础剑法修炼至化境。
武技境界除了入门、小成、大成、圆满四个境界之外，还有化境之说。
武技修炼至化境，化腐朽为神奇，招式返璞归真，威力将随之得到巨大的增幅。
这也是方羽，能够凭借基础剑法，重创阎息的最大原因。
若是基础剑法没有达到化境，方羽想要一击斩断阎息的右掌，根本不可能。
阎息如今可是半步灵武境，修为高过方羽太多。

Chapter 9 Transformation
Terrifying energy then bloomed from Yan Xi's palm.
There was a wave of air in the air.
That ray of cold light also struck Yan Xi's right palm.
"Ah. My hand."
And as that ray of cold light struck the right palm, Yan Xi suddenly let out a shrill scream.
Yan Xi held his right hand with his left hand, his face turned pale. At this time, blood was pouring out of his right hand. Half of the right palm was now missing, and only half of the index finger and thumb were left.
After Fang Yu succeeded in the attack, he ducked past Yan Xi and shot towards a mine.
"Damn it, was that the basic swordsmanship of the Perfect Realm just now? No, the basic swordsmanship of the Perfect Realm cannot have such power. Could it be the legendary Transformation Realm? Little beast, I won't let you go. Can you run away from a monk or a temple? I don't believe you don't leave the mine."
Yan Xi endured the severe pain in his right hand and looked at Fang Yu's retreating figure with a ferocious expression.
Then he hurriedly picked up the severed palm on the ground and shot it towards the corridor behind. He wanted to find the doctor in the mine to replace the severed palm, otherwise after that time, his palm would really be useless.
...
But at this time, Fang Yu, in desperation, had already entered the fifth level.
As soon as Fang Yu entered the fifth floor, he felt a chill coming over him and shuddered involuntarily.
"The chill on the fifth floor is actually much stronger than on the fourth floor."
Fang Yu said to himself with his body trembling slightly.
In just this moment, he felt that his limbs were a little stiff, which showed how strong the fifth level of chill was.
Fang Yu hurriedly found a corner and put the wooden sword in his hand back into his boots.
Fang Yu just relied on this wooden sword to cut off Yan Xi's right palm.
This wooden sword was made by Fang Yu some time ago.
In the past month, Fang Yu has not only practiced Dragon Fist to perfection.
Fang Yu spent only two days in the enlightenment state to perfect the first form of Dragon Fist.
Fang Yu spent the remaining eight days practicing sword skills.
However, Fang Yu did not practice any sword techniques, but only practiced basic sword techniques.
Thirteen basic sword techniques: drawing, bringing, lifting, blocking, striking, stabbing, point, collapsing, stirring, pressing, splitting, intercepting, and washing.
During this month, Fang Yu used nights to enter the realm of enlightenment.
He continued to practice this basic swordsmanship. In just one month, he had already mastered this basic swordsmanship to the realm of transformation.
In addition to the four realms of entry, small success, great success, and perfection, there is also the realm of transformation in martial arts realm.
When martial arts are practiced to the realm of transformation, decay becomes magical, and moves return to their original nature, their power will be greatly increased.
This is also the biggest reason why Fang Yu was able to severely damage Yan Xi with his basic sword skills.
If the basic swordsmanship had not reached the realm of transformation, it would be impossible for Fang Yu to cut off Yan Xi's right palm with one blow.
Yan Xi is now at the halfway level of the spiritual martial arts realm, and his cultivation level is much higher than Fang Yu's.
